text:
Ella M: Heads-up: platform will accept a canonical routing header next week: X-Route-Mode (values: latency, cost). They also want a tiny quota tag X-Q-Bucket. SDKs should normalize casing and accept legacy route_hint and routeHint as fallbacks. cc @Tom S

Tom S: Agree opt-in for GA. We'll add client option `RouteMode()` and env `REDWOOD_ROUTE_MODE=off|opt-in|mirror`. Default off in releases.

Rae (platform): Server will keep behavior same for 90 days and emit sampled `routing.legacy_seen`. We'll provide per-tenant sample rates. SDKs: please emit telemetry `sdk.route_remap` when remap happens.

build-bot: routing-api compat canary scheduled -> 2026-03-19 04:00 UTC :rocket: (link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/routing-api/compat)

Tom S: Quick pseudo for Go: `client.WithRouteMode("latency")` + env var support. Will log when remapping occurs and send telemetry event.

Ella M: DevEx: ship helpers behind flag. Add changelog guidance and migration snippet in release notes. Console wants a tiny tile "Routing remaps (sampled)" with link to examples.

Rae (platform): Confirmed: legacy header accepted until 2026-09-01. We'll emit `routing.header_conflict` when both headers present and attach trace link. Docs to be published tomorrow.

Tom S: I'll open PRs for Go/TS today with tests + telemetry.
